summary: Add generated per-face wall tiles and wallpaper with editable color and repeat size
breakingChanges: Projects using wall faceFinishes require an updated Cabane frontend on every standalone and HA client. Older clients reject this optional field without discarding data. Existing paint-only projects need no migration; the HA storage backend already preserves nested project fields unchanged.

history.summary: Explain newer workspace formats and automate matching HA releases
breakingChanges: Unknown fields remain blocked. Older panels must update in HACS before opening newer homes; the message now explains update, restart and reload steps.

history.summary: Ship the expanded rug catalog with workspace upgrade guidance
breakingChanges: Existing rug model and variant IDs remain supported. Workspaces using the new rug styles require this matching integration release; older panels must update through HACS before opening them.

history.summary: Animate garage door opening and closing smoothly
breakingChanges: No persisted data or model IDs change. Existing homes remain compatible; update the panel to receive smooth garage-door motion.

history.summary: Add the woven rattan bell pendant catalog preset
breakingChanges: Existing homes remain compatible. Homes using rattan-bell-pendant require the matching panel release; older panels must update before loading this new model.

history.summary: Make rattan bell pendants bindable light devices
breakingChanges: Existing furnishing pendants remain readable as hidden legacy items. New rattan-bell-pendant instances are light devices and require the matching panel release.

history.summary: Soften rattan pendant lighting and lower its bulb into the shade chamber
breakingChanges: No saved data changes. Existing pendants retain their placement and size, with reduced light intensity and a lower bulb and emitter in the updated panel.

history.summary: Stabilize orbital wall lighting and TV screen layers; add comic-book flight artwork
breakingChanges: No saved fields or model IDs change beyond the previously released pendant support. Existing homes remain compatible; update the panel for stable toon lighting during camera movement and the TV rendering fix and animation.

history.summary: Add live weather, private source selection and Weather action previews
breakingChanges: Existing profiles default to automatic weather. Homes saving a weather source or Weather action require the matching updated panel; older panels retain the unsupported-field recovery path. Public exports omit HA weather identifiers.

history.summary: Add wall-owned niches with solid backing and shared Construct controls
breakingChanges: Existing homes remain compatible. Homes saving wall niches require an updated panel; older panels keep unsupported fields blocked until updated through HACS.

history.summary: Allow imports and Save with unavailable catalog variants using default visuals
breakingChanges: Existing projects remain compatible. Missing furnishing and device variants now produce warnings and render the model default while retaining the saved variant ID; missing models retain placeholders. Older panels can reject newer variants until updated through HACS. Structural and unsupported-schema errors remain blocked.

history.summary: Support reversible solid structural spaces in room properties
breakingChanges: Older clients must update before importing projects containing the room isSolid field.
